summary: Today brings a mixed day driven by retail expansion aggressive revenue targets and significant litigation updates in Indian courts. Key highlights include major growth plans from retail players like U.S. Polo Assn. and Beco, alongside legal assurances given to the Bombay High Court.

bullets.text: Bank of Baroda assured the Bombay High Court it will preserve all records concerning BR Shetty’s $15 billion fraud lawsuit.
Reliance plans to build a 1,600-satellite network to challenge Starlink in India's satellite communications market.
U.S. Polo Assn. announced a revenue target of ₹4,000 crore in sales across India by FY27.
Home care brand Beco aims to expand its presence to over 25,000 general trade stores across India within 2 to 3 years.
Chief Economic Adviser V. Anantha Nageswaran stated that Indian capital markets must serve the real economy and align with development goals.
